name: elephant-birds-vanish-madagascar
description: The largest birds ever to live, towering flightless giants of an Indian Ocean island, vanished after people settled there.

name: moa-extinct-new-zealand
description: Hunting by the first Polynesian settlers wiped out all nine species of towering flightless birds within about a century.

name: stellers-sea-cow-hunted-out
friendly_name: Steller's Sea Cow Is Hunted Out
description: A giant, gentle relative of the manatee was wiped out in the Bering Sea within decades of its discovery by Europeans.

name: last-great-auks-killed
friendly_name: The Last Great Auks Are Killed
description: Fishermen strangled the last known pair of the North Atlantic's flightless penguin-like seabird on a rocky Icelandic islet.

name: last-cape-lion-shot
description: The large black-maned lion of South Africa's southern tip was shot out by hunters and settlers, ending a distinct subspecies.

name: tasmanian-emu-extinct
description: A dwarf emu of an island south of Australia was shot out by settlers and its last birds vanished from the wild.

name: falkland-islands-wolf-extinct
friendly_name: The Falkland Islands Wolf Is Killed
description: The only native land mammal of its remote South Atlantic archipelago was hunted and poisoned out by settlers and sheep farmers.

name: last-labrador-duck-shot
description: A shy sea duck of the North American Atlantic coast vanished with almost no record of why, the first endemic bird lost there.

name: stephens-island-wren-extinct
description: A tiny flightless songbird of a small New Zealand island was destroyed soon after a lighthouse keeper's cat arrived.

name: rocky-mountain-locust-extinct
description: Swarms once the size of a large state had darkened the American plains, yet the insect was gone after one last live specimen.

name: huia-last-seen
description: A prized New Zealand songbird, whose tail feathers were worn as ornaments and whose forest was cleared, was last seen alive.

name: last-carolina-parakeet-dies
description: The only parrot native to the eastern United States ended its story when its last captive, Incas, died in a Cincinnati zoo.

name: last-wild-barbary-lion-shot
description: The big, dark-maned lion of North Africa, a favourite of the Roman arena, was last shot in the wild in the Atlas Mountains.

name: last-heath-hen-booming-ben
friendly_name: Booming Ben, the Last Heath Hen
description: The final eastern prairie chicken, a lone male nicknamed for his call, was last seen on an island off Massachusetts.

name: xerces-blue-butterfly-extinct
friendly_name: The Xerces Blue Butterfly Is Lost
description: A small blue butterfly of the San Francisco peninsula became the first American insect known to vanish through urban development.

name: caribbean-monk-seal-last-sighted
description: The only seal native to the warm Caribbean waters was last seen on a remote bank, after centuries of hunting for oil.

name: caspian-tiger-extinct
description: A long-legged tiger of the lands around an inland sea was last seen, victim of hunting and the loss of its river forests.

name: javan-tiger-last-recorded
friendly_name: The Javan Tiger Is Last Recorded
description: A small island tiger, once found across its Indonesian homeland, slipped away as forests were turned into farmland.

name: dusky-seaside-sparrow-last-dies
description: The final bird of a marsh sparrow found only on one Florida coast died in captivity, a lone male named Orange Band.

name: golden-toad-last-seen
friendly_name: The Golden Toad Is Last Seen
description: A brilliant orange amphibian from one Costa Rican cloud forest vanished, a warning sign of climate change and disease.

name: celia-last-pyrenean-ibex-dies
description: The last wild wild-goat of her mountain range was found crushed by a fallen tree, later briefly cloned, then lost again.

name: pouli-last-seen-hawaii
description: A rare, drab-looking Hawaiian forest bird, discovered only a few decades earlier, was last seen after a rescue attempt failed.

name: baiji-functionally-extinct
description: A survey of the Yangtze failed to find a single freshwater dolphin, the first dolphin lost to human activity.

name: lonesome-george-dies
description: The last Pinta Island giant tortoise, long the world's rarest creature, died in the Galapagos after decades without a mate.

name: chinese-paddlefish-declared-extinct
description: One of the largest freshwater fish on Earth, a Yangtze giant from the age of dinosaurs, was officially declared lost.
